entries.title: I Corinthians 12:1
segments: Now concerning spiritual [gifts], brethren, I would not have you ignorant.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:2
segments: Ye know that when ye were Gentiles [ye were] led away unto those dumb idols, howsoever ye might led.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:3
segments: Wherefore I make known unto you, that no man speaking in the Spirit of God saith, Jesus is anathema; and no man can say, Jesus is Lord, but in the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:4
segments: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:5
segments: And there are diversities of ministrations, and the same Lord.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:6
segments: And there are diversities of workings, but the same God, who worketh all things in all.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:7
segments: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit to profit withal.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:8
segments: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom; and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit:

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:9
segments: to another faith, in the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, in the one Spirit;

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:10
segments: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits; to another [divers] kinds of tongues; and to another the interpretation of tongues:

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:11
segments: but all these worketh the one and the same Spirit, dividing to each one severally even as he will.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:12
segments: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:13
segments: For in one Spirit were we all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all made to drink of one Spirit.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:14
segments: For the body is not one member, but many.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:15
segments: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:16
segments: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; it is not therefore not of the body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:17
segments: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:18
segments: But now hath God set the members each one of them in the body, even as it pleased him.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:19
segments: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:20
segments: But now they are many members, but one body.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:21
segments: And the eye cannot say to the hand, I have no need of thee: or again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:22
segments: Nay, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be more feeble are necessary:

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:23
segments: and those [parts] of the body, which we think to be less honorable, upon these we bestow more abundant honor; and our uncomely [parts] have more abundant comeliness;

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:24
segments: whereas our comely [parts] have no need: but God tempered the body together, giving more abundant honor to that [part] which lacked;

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:25
segments: that there should be no schism in the body; but [that] the members should have the same care one for another.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:26
segments: And whether one member suffereth, all the members suffer with it; or [one] member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:27
segments: Now ye are the body of Christ, and severally members thereof.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:28
segments: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, then miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, [divers] kinds of tongues.

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:29
segments: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all [workers of] miracles?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:30
segments: have all gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?

entries.title: I Corinthians 12:31
segments: But desire earnestly the greater gifts. And moreover a most excellent way show I unto you.
